purpose: A design and procurement dependency graph, not a game launcher or autonomous purchasing system.
estimate_units: person-hours; planning assumptions, not elapsed-time promises

requirements.text: Golden Tee, exact release to be selected; preserve trackball feel
Big Buck Hunter, exact release and alternating/simultaneous player mode to be selected
Silver Strike, exact release to be selected; another bowling game does not satisfy this requirement
Jurassic Park Arcade, exact release to be selected; 1994, 1997 and 2015 are distinct branches
Do not commit irreversible fabrication or game-hardware spending before version-specific bench proof
Basement installation fits access route and preserves egress, electrical and mechanical safety
Planning deliverable specifies and illustrates all four game experiences with source-scoped controls and prototype acceptance
Planning deliverable shows finished-product and room concepts and works interactively in the owner's X1 browser
Planning deliverable includes a bounded production offer, reproducible economics, liquidity obligations and explicit commercial release gates
Distinguish display/input upgrades, conditional renderer modifications and separately funded new-engine development for all four games
Share the reviewed presentation over anonymous HTTPS without publishing private operational records
Create an honestly labeled immersive concept film independently of the presentation release

interfaces.to: selected emulator or original game I/O
interfaces.contract: Relative X/Y plus separate buttons; USB HID only for PC path, original encoder pinout for donor path; no assumed interchangeability

interfaces.from: two optical USB guns or two positional analog assemblies
interfaces.contract: Independent player identity, calibrated X/Y, trigger and title-specific secondary input; outputs such as recoil are a separate safe interface
Documented signal format/refresh, correct aspect, game mode, no overscan; original CRT video may require a proven scaler
Measured housing, VESA, connector and service envelopes; supplier templates precede holes

risks.mitigation: Record exact title/year/build and a cabinet photo before compatibility decisions
Do not budget Silver Strike as a free MAME game; prove complete original donor system or a genuinely supported authorized alternative
For Raw Thrills 2015 retain authentic PC/dongle/I/O unless another lawful runtime passes; mounted-gun geometry is a separate branch
Test actual display, room lighting, lens field of view and near/far player positions
Measure narrowest stair/door and landings; modular furniture and actual TV carton must fit
Static analysis is evidence of code structure, not proof of runtime support or permission to copy protected content
Listed alternatives differ in scope and stock; batch size is not demand. Require a defined offer, qualified interviews and paid pilot evidence.
Recover initial tooling once; distinguish contribution from business profit, fund startup/support costs and retain explicit customer-refund liquidity.
Verify the public build end-to-end on the device(s) actually used for review before delivering.
